steps.title: After Spell-in-Waiting: Return on you
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: ShellCrusherTarget).

OffTank.rule: If you are in IceHolder: Stand on waymark 3; otherwise: Stand at the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: When ShellCrusherTarget leaves out H2 and IceHolder leaves out H2, stand at the centre; when ShellCrusherTarget includes H2 and IceHolder includes H2, stand on waymark 3; when ShellCrusherTarget includes H2 and IceHolder leaves out H2, stand near waymark 1, 14m north-west of the centre.
